scripts.dev:desktop: node scripts/ensure-electron-native-deps.mjs && concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names renderer,electron-build,electron --prefix-colors green,yellow,magenta "npm run dev --workspace renderer" "npm run build:watch --workspace electron" "npx wait-on http-get://127.0.0.1:1420 file:electron/dist/main/index.js file:electron/dist/preload/index.js && npm run start --workspace electron"
scripts.build: node scripts/ensure-electron-native-deps.mjs && npm run build --workspace renderer && npm run make --workspace electron
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace electron && npm run typecheck --workspace renderer
